description: Sets up Cosend’s “AI receptionist” automation on one WhatsApp number: Answers your customers on WhatsApp from what you teach it, and passes a chat to you when needed. Its settings are this recipe’s own, as its set-up form in Cosend asks them; a setting left out takes its default. It is set up switched off, and acts only once it is switched on. The same recipe is set up once on each number, or once per source when it asks for one. The preview refuses a second one as the save would, and gives no token. Each call needs confirming: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview with the settings as Cosend filled them in and its check of them, and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it saves. Returns the automation, switched off.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

connection_id.description: The WhatsApp number (connection id) this automation belongs to: its triggers come from it, its messages go from it, and its templates are read on it. Required, and it cannot be moved afterwards. The same recipe (slug) can be set up once on each number, or once per source on it when the recipe has `multiple`.

name.description: Its name in Cosend. Left out, it takes the recipe’s name.

settings.description: The recipe’s settings, as its set-up form asks them. A setting left out takes its default; a setting with no default is needed.

closed_holding_message.default: Thanks for your message. We are closed right now. A person will reply when we open, {opens}.
closed_holding_message.description: Where it says {opens}, the customer reads when you next open.
closed_holding_message.title: What it says when it passes a chat to you while you are closed

closed_message.default: Thanks for your message. We are closed right now, and our assistant will answer you in the meantime.
closed_message.description: Sent once when a customer writes while you are closed, followed by your opening hours. The assistant still answers.
closed_message.title: Closed message

escalate_keywords.description: When a customer writes one of these, the chat comes to you. Add them in the languages your customers write in.
escalate_keywords.title: Words that pass a chat to you

hand_back.description: After the quiet period with no reply, the assistant sends your keep-alive message once. The chat stays with you.
hand_back.title: Keep the chat alive if nobody answers

holding_message.default: One moment, I am getting a colleague to help.
holding_message.title: What it says when it passes a chat to you

keep_alive_message.default: Sorry for the wait, we will answer you as soon as possible.
keep_alive_message.description: Sent once to the customer after the quiet period, while the chat waits for you, for example “Sorry for the wait, we will answer you as soon as possible.”
keep_alive_message.title: Keep-alive message

new_contacts_only.description: Answers only people who first write after you switch this on. Your existing customers stay with your team.
new_contacts_only.title: Answer new contacts only

quiet_period.description: How long with no reply from you and no new message from the customer before the assistant sends the keep-alive.
quiet_period.title: Quiet period

weekly_hours.description: Each open day with its own opening and closing time, for example Saturday 09:00 to 14:00. A day not listed is closed. Left empty, the hours above apply on each open day.
weekly_hours.title: Opening hours per day

name: set_up_ai_receptionist
title: Set up “AI receptionist”
